name: Corn & Soybeans: Does Curve Structure Predict Roll Yield?
description: Tests whether backwardation (positive carry) in corn and soybean futures predicts higher forward 63-day returns. Uses raw carry from futures continuation as the signal and 63-trading-day forward price returns (BackwardRatio adjusted) as the outcome. Outputs: carry time series, scatter of carry vs forward return, regime flip event markers, and summary statistics by regime.
source:
# Corn & Soybeans: Does Futures Curve Structure Predict Next-Quarter Roll Yield?
# Signal: raw carry from futures_continuation (positive = backwardation, negative = contango)
# Outcome: 63-trading-day forward price return on BackwardRatio-adjusted series
# Both ZC and ZS run the same symmetric formula independently

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
carry = cont.carry
ts = index().value

# --- Transforms ---
# Forward 63-day price return (includes roll yield on adjusted series)
fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(close)

# Regime classification (NaN-guarded)
is_backwardation = is_valid(carry) and carry > 0
is_contango = is_valid(carry) and carry <= 0

# Regime-filtered forward returns for summary stats
fwd_in_backwardation = where(is_backwardation, fwd_63d)
fwd_in_contango = where(is_contango, fwd_63d)

# Hit rate series: 1.0 if forward return > 0, 0.0 otherwise, filtered by regime
# NaN-guard fwd_63d before comparison
hit_back = where(is_backwardation and is_valid(fwd_63d), 1.0 if fwd_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_cont = where(is_contango and is_valid(fwd_63d), 1.0 if fwd_63d > 0 else 0.0)

# Regime flip detection for event markers (manual crossing — no crossover builtin)
carry_prev = carry >> 1
flip_to_backwardation = is_valid(carry) and is_valid(carry_prev) and carry > 0 and carry_prev <= 0
flip_to_contango = is_valid(carry) and is_valid(carry_prev) and carry <= 0 and carry_prev > 0
any_flip = flip_to_backwardation or flip_to_contango

# Regime label for event card
regime_label = 'Backwardation' if flip_to_backwardation else 'Contango'

# --- Output 1: Carry Time Series (CONTEXT) ---
xy_lines(
    title='Where Is the Curve Today?',
    category='Curve vs Roll Yield',
    y_axis_label='Carry (Front - Back)',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Carry', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Flat Curve')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=carry)

# --- Output 2: Scatter — Carry vs Forward Return (PUNCHLINE) ---
xy_scatter(
    title='Does Higher Carry Predict Better Returns?',
    category='Curve vs Roll Yield',
    x_axis_label='Carry (Front - Back)',
    y_axis_label='63-Day Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero Return')
    ]),
    show_trend_line=True,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Daily Obs', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x=carry, y_values=fwd_63d)

# --- Output 3: Summary Table — Regime Stats (REFERENCE) ---
# 10 cells mapped 1:1 to 10 inputs by position
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Curve vs Roll Yield',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Backwardation vs Contango: 63-Day Forward Returns',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['N (Days)', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (>0%)', 'Best', 'Worst'],
        col_headers=['Backwardation', 'Contango'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(fwd_in_backwardation, fwd_in_contango, fwd_in_backwardation, fwd_in_contango, hit_back, hit_cont, fwd_in_backwardation, fwd_in_contango, fwd_in_backwardation, fwd_in_contango)

# --- Event Markers: Regime Flips ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Curve Regime Flip',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='New Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry Level', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Close Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(regime_label, carry, close, any_flip)
